name: AirStream-V1.3.0
body:
> [!NOTE]
> ## Release Highlights
> This release fixes the recent video playback issues and that playlists contain no videos.
> 
> To overcome the video playback issues, we implemented YouTube's new, custom streaming protocol (called SABR). YouTube started to progressively remove support for traditional streaming protocols, so Airstream's support for the new protocol should make video playback much more reliable.
> 
> Apart from this, the release includes support for podcasts and courses tabs on channels, a "resume all" option for downloads, as well as many minor bug fixes and small improvements.
### :sparkles: New Features
- [`73d3ca0`](https://github.com/d0x-dev/AirStream/commit/73d3ca01c19e1f59b82074973ae80c67d635d78b) - implement floating PIP miniplayer *(commit by @d0x-dev)*
- [`b90261d`](https://github.com/d0x-dev/AirStream/commit/b90261d6b228745371cb7ccad4b1f0c02af9a933) - hide appbar and bottom nav on scroll *(commit by @d0x-dev)*
- [`43b34c9`](https://github.com/d0x-dev/AirStream/commit/43b34c951726508441ad9e3b37bfca82a41fa1f8) - pre-cache shorts with ExoPlayer pool *(commit by @d0x-dev)*

### :bug: Bug Fixes
- [`5053e8e`](https://github.com/d0x-dev/AirStream/commit/5053e8eccbc5bfce258e92a6587ff93cbfa53950) - make PIP drag work correctly, shrink size, add rounded corners *(commit by @d0x-dev)*
- [`62a9486`](https://github.com/d0x-dev/AirStream/commit/62a9486967695195708092e0a3c2a5c1d89ddd2d) - correctly position and size miniplayer buttons in motion scene *(commit by @d0x-dev)*
- [`ae6229f`](https://github.com/d0x-dev/AirStream/commit/ae6229f2aedce51f4eeecec620df28442e7b226f) - add miniplayer progress bar and fix button nullable error *(commit by @d0x-dev)*
- [`13ed3f0`](https://github.com/d0x-dev/AirStream/commit/13ed3f01fe482c6ef0f3e2ad9e55badcfe169778) - attach progress bar to miniplayer drag, shrink button size, move to top corners *(commit by @d0x-dev)*
- [`5beaeed`](https://github.com/d0x-dev/AirStream/commit/5beaeedeae4413638add1b78a3c0ebde94781b43) - bind home feed to trending recommendations instead of empty local feed *(commit by @d0x-dev)*
- [`3686fdf`](https://github.com/d0x-dev/AirStream/commit/3686fdfbb026722286ad3b6cacd864ab22abd4f8) - restore nothing_here empty state, fix load spinner overlap *(commit by @d0x-dev)*
- [`2a85ec9`](https://github.com/d0x-dev/AirStream/commit/2a85ec9bd8742f0300e572d7cd7cd5d1271f5ca5) - use fitsSystemWindows to allow AppBarLayout to scroll out of view completely *(commit by @d0x-dev)*
- [`079068e`](https://github.com/d0x-dev/AirStream/commit/079068e19b15b981b3b69f1f55f31504c43e41c1) - use dummy space view instead of fitsSystemWindows on AppBarLayout to allow complete native scroll hiding *(commit by @d0x-dev)*
- [`fbcf916`](https://github.com/d0x-dev/AirStream/commit/fbcf916a5a35421b57905a43eacad4236d055d04) - refactor search screen to hide chips properly on scroll *(commit by @d0x-dev)*
- [`c78be76`](https://github.com/d0x-dev/AirStream/commit/c78be76e1a0b2dd5c07769f18d2154e731deafb1) - player background showing home screen in status bar *(commit by @d0x-dev)*

### :wrench: Chores
- [`daf7a4c`](https://github.com/d0x-dev/AirStream/commit/daf7a4c3612818bc49a1adce5005c25b93a7f9a7) - purge all remaining libretube branding references *(commit by @d0x-dev)*
